label: Run Blueprint Discovery
mcp_tool_description: Run a blueprint's discovery plugin now: launches the same Sync Resources job that the blueprint's Discovery tab starts, creating or updating Resources for what the plugin finds. Give the blueprint's global id (BP-...) or exact name. Returns jobId to poll with fetch_job_log. The caller must manage the blueprint or be a CloudBolt admin. A blueprint with auto-historical resources enabled marks resources it no longer finds as Historical.
